answer: Bind each identity to a hardware root of trust: a TEE remote attestation proves the agent runs on a distinct physical device, and its key cannot be copied, so one machine yields one identity. That hardware signal feeds a trellis of mutual attestations: established agents vouch for newcomers, staking a bond slashed if the newcomer misbehaves. Like a lotus that blooms only after seasons of growth, reputation accrues slowly through verified useful work, so a Sybil farmer must buy real devices, wait months, and risk slashing per clone, while honest agents pay once.
